name: free-new-assets
title: Permanently free assets published recently
summary: List permanently free assets Fab published since a date, newest first

inputs.name: Since
inputs.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD; compute it ('this week' is today minus 7 days, 'this month' the 1st)

steps.why: The server filters by date; owned marks what the user already has
steps.check: results[].title and owned; cursors.next for more

notes: is_free=1 is only the permanently free bucket. The Limited Time Free promos need min_discount_percentage=100 (playbook claim-promos). If the user just said 'free', ask which they mean.
Add --filter channels=unreal-engine to keep to Unreal Engine assets.
